FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I make a same-day reservation?

Yes, subject to vehicle availability.

Do you offer airport transfers?

Paid transfers to Ishigaki Airport and the ferry terminal are available. Please contact us in advance.

Do you offer child seats?

¥1,000 per seat. Reservation required.

Can I rent with an International Driving Permit?

Yes, a valid International Driving Permit (IDP) is accepted.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept cash, major credit cards, transportation IC cards, PayPay, Rakuten Pay, au PAY, and QUICPay.

Can I use my personal auto insurance?

If your personal auto insurance includes coverage for driving another vehicle, it may apply to your rental. Please ask our staff for details.

Is there a cancellation fee?

Cancellation is free until 18:00 two days before the reservation. The fee is 50% the day before and 100% on the day. No cancellation fee is charged for flight cancellations or weather-related cancellations such as typhoons.
